title: A modular analysis of the Fujisaki-Okamoto transformation
authors: D Hofheinz, K Hövelmanns, E Kiltz
abstract: Abstract The Fujisaki-Okamoto (FO) transformation (CRYPTO 1999 and Journal of Cryptology 2013) turns any weakly secure public-key encryption scheme into a strongly (ie,) secure one in the random oracle model. Unfortunately, the FO analysis suffers from several drawbacks, such as a non-tight security reduction, and the need for a perfectly correct scheme.
